# LKS 360-SCHREINER LLC

> Florida limited liability company (Document No. L26000221347, founded 20 April 2026). Independent broker for used and surplus power generation equipment: gas turbines, steam turbines and generator sets, offered on behalf of their owners. Managed by Lothar Schreiner, Managing Member.

## Company facts
- Legal name: LKS 360-SCHREINER LLC
- Legal form: Florida limited liability company
- Florida Document No.: L26000221347

- Registered office: 7901 4th St N, Ste 300, St. Petersburg, FL 33702, USA
- Managing Member: Lothar Schreiner
- Email: manager@lks360.com
- Phone: +49 170 4656619
- Website: https://lks360.com
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/142908032

## Business
- Gas turbines: industrial and aeroderivative packages, 50 and 60 Hz, new, unused or overhauled.
- Steam turbines: generator sets for power plants and industrial cogeneration.
- Generator sets: gas and diesel, for industrial and utility projects.
- Role: independent broker on commission. Equipment stays with its owner until the sale. The purchase contract is made between buyer and owner. LKS 360-SCHREINER LLC does not take title to the equipment.
- Process: buyer requirement, offer with the owner's conditions, letter of intent and inspection, purchase contract between buyer and owner.
- Compliance: counterparties are screened against OFAC, EU and UN sanction lists. No business with sanctioned persons, entities or embargoed countries.

## Related company
- LKS 360 IMPORT EXPORT TRADING SERVICE CO., LTD (Vietnam, tax code 0314542902), https://lks360exim.com, is a separate legal entity.
